material.acceptance_criteria: the server answers initialize, didOpen, completion and publishDiagnostics for a mod file in a CI job, with diagnostics matching the engine's own validation.
material.description: A language server for .star and Lua mods: diagnostics, completion and hover generated from the engine's data schema, so mod authors get the same schema the engine validates against. New crate rust/crates/mod-lsp.
material.resolution: Stdio LSP crate rust/crates/mod-lsp: diagnostics from osdt_data::generate, completion and hover from builtins. No network port. CI job drives initialize, didOpen, completion, shutdown and compares with the engine CLI. Gaps recorded: lua diagnostics absent, line-0 positions, no URI percent-decoding, only grid checked in completion.
material.subject: Language server for mod files driven by the engine schema
